title: MCP getUsage({daily: true, key: [...]}) silently drops the key filter — and its description says it can't filter
author: NamanSoni78

gist.summary: MCP getUsage now forwards the key filter as comma-separated api_key_ids when daily is true, so daily usage can be limited to selected API keys instead of returning usage across all keys. The tool description no longer says key filtering is history-only, and a test checks that both key IDs reach /account/usage/daily.
